name: Love Season
source:
Love Season tells a coming-of-age story about a young, socially-awkward farmer who sees his life turn upside down after a mysterious storm hits his village, destroying his farm and causing all sorts of problems to his acquaintances, friends and family.

The need to step up to help people around leads him on a new path to breaking out of his shell, going on adventures, risking his life and eventually getting the attention of women he could once only dream about.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Love Season》講述了一名年輕農夫的成長故事。他不善交際，原本平靜的生活卻在一場神秘風暴襲擊村莊後徹底顛覆。風暴摧毀了他的農場，也給熟人、朋友與家人帶來了種種麻煩。

為了挺身而出、幫助身邊的人，他踏上了一條全新的道路，逐漸走出自我封閉，經歷冒險，冒著生命危險前行，最終贏得了那些他過去只敢在夢中奢望的女性的關注。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732050/]Steam[/url]］
